info.name: SYRTAK Flutter API
info.description:
Production-quality Postman kit for the Flutter team integrating with SYRTAK / DLMS.

How to use:
1. Import this Collection + SYRTAK_Local environment
2. Select environment SYRTAK Local
3. Run 00 - Start Here top → bottom
4. Follow 20 - Full Citizen Flows for end-to-end paths
5. Toggle app_language = ar|en for localization

Citizen APIs use Accept-Language + Bearer {{citizen_token}}.
Dashboard APIs are under 90 and use {{employee_token}} (no locale header).
Tokens/IDs are auto-captured by test scripts.
